title: Code Zero's Automation
description: The CZM Automation Pack is a huge modpack focused on Automating everything. This pack should have a good balance of difficulty and fun and has all types of mods ranging from botania to create.
body:
The CZM Automation Pack is a huge modpack focused on Automating everything. This pack should have a good balance of difficulty and fun and has all types of mods ranging from botania to create. Let you imagination run wild with nearly 300 mods! The amount of mods will keep you playing the same world for as long as you wish, never running out of things to create. If you like automation, this is your dream pack. Build a crop farm with botany pots or create, build your house with blocks from chipped, and decorate it with the multitude of furniture mods; automate mining with computercraft! If you're an advanced player, great! set up your own turtles to work for you! If you're on the less advanced side, or just want a relaxing playthrough, great! These mods know no limits, there's something for everyone.

PLEASE READ:

- This Modpack is not recommended for people with low end computers.
- Please ensure you have enough ram allocated to the pack before playing, 8 GB is plenty, 4 GB is the recommended minimum
- Minecraft's mod loading is weird. Mods don't always load in the same order, meaning sometimes you may get a "(mod) failed to load correctly" simply hit play again and it should work. This is nothing I can fix because of the number of mods in this pack.
